project_info.theme: Vinamilk yogurt as an afternoon treat
project_info.color_palette: Soft butter yellow, warm brown, pastel blue gingham, fruit tones

main_subject.detail: A sunny tabletop food scene with the headline 'Sữa chua ăn Vinamilk CHIỀU MỜI BỮA'. On a blue gingham placemat are several Vinamilk oat-based yogurt cups, one open with pale yogurt and a spoon. A circular badge says 'SỮA CHUA ĂN THỰC VẬT ĐẦU TIÊN TẠI VIỆT NAM'. The scene includes pancakes or crepes with cream and fruit, a tea glass, and a yellow mug.
main_subject.style: Bright food-lifestyle editorial with cheerful afternoon-snack styling
